newsitem.title: UK: Russian PM halts nickel sell-off - FT report.
newsitem.headline: Russian PM halts nickel sell-off - FT report.

text.p: Russian prime minister Victor Chernomyrdin has ordered the postponement of the government's sale of its 38 percent stake in Norilsk Nickel, according to a report in the Financial Times on Tuesday.

The report said the decision was made on Monday night on the eve of its scheduled launch later Tuesday. Chernomyrdin said the auction procedures had to be reviewed to make sure they complied with the law but has not said when the sale will proceed, said the FT.
The report added that legal experts believed the terms of the sale could not be changed, however .
Norilsk Nickel is seen as one of Russia's most valuable companies, holding 35 percent of the world's nickel reserves and the government stake has an estimated value of more than $750 million.
